verdict.rationale: Quo's homepage states that its AI agent Sona answers when the team can't, captures the needed details, and hands the conversation to the team, which matches all three elements of the story. The pricing page's call transfers and the transcribed, summarized calls support the handoff and message-capture context. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on Sona's configuration, message-taking and handoff mechanics (e.g., live transfer vs. notification), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
